title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A responsive personal site built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, featuring an auto-generated nav bar, dark mode, and data-driven project pages.

title: Data Visualization Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard that visualizes public datasets with D3, including filtering, tooltips, and linked views.

title: Movie Recommendation System
description: A collaborative-filtering recommender trained on movie ratings data, with an evaluation of accuracy across different similarity metrics.

title: Housing Price Prediction
description: A regression pipeline using feature engineering and cross-validation to predict housing prices from neighborhood and property data.

title: Spotify Listening Analysis
description: An exploratory analysis of personal listening history, uncovering trends in genres, artists, and listening times.

title: Task Manager App
description: A full-stack to-do application with user accounts, drag-and-drop task ordering, and persistent storage.

title: Weather Forecast Widget
description: A lightweight web widget that fetches live forecasts from a public weather API and displays them with simple icons.

title: Sentiment Analysis of Reviews
description: A natural language processing project classifying product reviews as positive or negative using TF-IDF and logistic regression.

title: COVID-19 Trends Explorer
description: An interactive map and time-series explorer of case and vaccination data across U.S. counties.

title: Sudoku Solver
description: A backtracking-based Sudoku solver with a visual step-by-step mode that animates how the algorithm works.

title: Campus Event Finder
description: A web app that aggregates student organization events into a searchable, filterable calendar.

title: Snake Game
description: A classic Snake game built in JavaScript with the Canvas API, featuring increasing difficulty and a high-score tracker.
